pawn.name: Rally II
pawn.desc: Rally: move the 3 closest allied pieces onto free tiles adjacent to this pawn.

pawn.name: Rally III
pawn.desc: Rally: move every other allied piece onto a free tile adjacent to this pawn.

pawn.name: Lantern Signal
pawn.desc: Unlock: clear the snow in a 3x3 area around every allied piece.

pawn.name: Lantern Signal II
pawn.desc: Lantern Signal: clear the snow in a 3x3 + cross-shaped area around every allied piece.

pawn.name: Lantern Signal III
pawn.desc: Lantern Signal: clear the snow in a 5x5 area around every allied piece.

pawn.name: Promotion
pawn.desc: Unlock: this pawn permanently becomes a knight for the rest of this battle.

pawn.name: Promotion II
pawn.desc: Promotion: this pawn permanently becomes a rook for the rest of this battle.

pawn.name: Promotion III
pawn.desc: Promotion: this pawn permanently becomes a queen for the rest of this battle.

pawn.name: Fresh Powder
pawn.desc: Battles start with snow cleared in 5x5 around each pawn.

knight.name: Evade II
knight.desc: Evade can be used 3 times per battle.

knight.name: Evade III
knight.desc: Evade can be used 4 times per battle.

knight.name: Reposition
knight.desc: Unlock: make an extra move with this knight without ending your turn.

knight.name: Reposition II
knight.desc: Reposition can be used 2 times per battle.

knight.name: Reposition III
knight.desc: Reposition can be used 3 times per battle.

knight.name: Pathfinder
knight.desc: After this knight moves, snow clears in 3x3 around its landing tile.

knight.name: Ambush
knight.desc: Unlock: jump to any snow-free empty tile within 3 tiles.

knight.name: Ambush II
knight.desc: Ambush: jump to any snow-free empty tile within 4 tiles.

knight.name: Ambush III
knight.desc: Ambush: jump to any snow-free empty tile within 5 tiles, 2 uses per battle.

bishop.name: Longshot II
bishop.desc: Longshot: capture one enemy piece within line of sight (diagonal or straight), without moving.

bishop.name: Longshot III
bishop.desc: Longshot: capture one enemy piece within line of sight (diagonal or straight), without moving.

bishop.name: Traps
bishop.desc: Unlock: until this bishop moves, enemies within 3x3 of its tile cannot move at all.

bishop.name: Traps II
bishop.desc: Traps: until this bishop moves, enemies within a 3x3 + cross-shaped area of its tile cannot move at all.

bishop.name: Traps III
bishop.desc: Traps: until this bishop moves, enemies within 5x5 of its tile cannot move at all.

bishop.name: Vigil
bishop.desc: Battles start with snow cleared in 3x3 around each bishop.

bishop.name: Sanctify
bishop.desc: Unlock: remove curses from all allied pieces within 3x3 of this bishop.

bishop.name: Sanctify II
bishop.desc: Sanctify: remove curses from all allied pieces within a 3x3 + cross-shaped area of this bishop.

bishop.name: Sanctify III
bishop.desc: Sanctify: remove curses from all allied pieces within 5x5 of this bishop.

rook.name: Lookout II
rook.desc: Lookout: reveal the closest fog-obscured enemy and clear the snow in a 3x3 + cross-shaped area around them.

rook.name: Lookout III
rook.desc: Lookout: reveal the closest fog-obscured enemy and clear the snow in 5x5 around them.

rook.name: Reinforce
rook.desc: Unlock: until this rook moves, no enemy can move onto any tile within 3x3 of its tile.

rook.name: Reinforce II
rook.desc: Reinforce: until this rook moves, no enemy can move onto any tile within a 3x3 + cross-shaped area of its tile.

rook.name: Reinforce III
rook.desc: Reinforce: until this rook moves, no enemy can move onto any tile within 5x5 of its tile.

rook.name: Watchtower
rook.desc: Battles start with snow cleared in 3x3 around each rook.

rook.name: Castling
rook.desc: Unlock: swap positions with your king if he is in this rook's line of sight.

rook.name: Castling II
rook.desc: Castling: swap positions with any ally in this rook's line of sight.

rook.name: Castling III
rook.desc: Castling: swap positions with any allied piece anywhere.

queen.name: Exterminate II
queen.desc: Exterminate: the blast destroys all enemies within a 3x3 + cross-shaped area of the queen.

queen.name: Exterminate III
queen.desc: Exterminate: the blast destroys all enemies within 5x5 of the queen.

queen.name: Lure
queen.desc: Unlock: force the closest enemy to move toward this queen on their next move, but they cannot capture her.

queen.name: Lure II
queen.desc: Lure: forces the 3 closest enemies to move toward this queen.

queen.name: Lure III
queen.desc: Lure: every enemy is forced to move toward this queen.

queen.name: Command
queen.desc: Unlock: a chosen ally in this queen's line of sight may immediately make a free move.

queen.name: Command II
queen.desc: Command: any chosen ally may immediately make a free move.

queen.name: Command III
queen.desc: Command can be used 2 times per battle.

queen.name: Scorched Earth
queen.desc: Exterminate's blast also clears all snow in its area.

king.name: Cleanse II
king.desc: Cleanse: convert the 3 closest enemies within line of sight into temporary allies for the rest of this battle.

king.name: Cleanse III
king.desc: Cleanse: convert every enemy within line of sight into a temporary ally for the rest of this battle.

king.name: Heal
king.desc: Unlock: revive the most recently fallen ally onto an empty tile within this king's line of sight.

king.name: Heal II
king.desc: Heal: revive up to 3 of the most recently fallen allies.

king.name: Royal Decree
king.desc: Unlock: allies within 3x3 of the king cannot be captured until your next turn.

king.name: Royal Decree II
king.desc: Royal Decree: protects allies in a 3x3 + cross-shaped area around the king.

king.name: Royal Decree III
king.desc: Royal Decree: no ally can be captured until your next turn.

king.name: Beacon of Hope
king.desc: Battles start with snow cleared in 5x5 around the king.
